body:
Model observations and steering audits previously needed separate demo-specific plots. This adds the approved D-044 base-R interface for a model-block map, bounded paired activation comparisons and applied-coefficient timelines, with numerical tables available for export.

Comparisons validate recorded model/settings/prompt and full prior generated-token history; divergent prefixes withhold differences and missing top-k values stay unknown. Timelines show the actual next-decode boundary, including truncated history. The map describes metadata/configured interventions, not measured activity or causal edges. Caller provenance is not authenticated.

Actual managed-spill testing also found live capture filenames lacked the `trace-` prefix required by the existing lease. The narrow R correction restores compatibility before metadata accounting; the native writer, security checks and limits remain unchanged. No new dependency, native/vendor change or inference path.

### Validation

- Independent reference committed before implementation; one integrated review and targeted correction closure.
- Fresh isolated R installation: 24 cases / 110 expectations, no skips or test warnings; after the prefix correction, affected spill tests: 3 cases / 14 expectations. Unchanged cases retain parent-source scope.
- Three actual cached-Qwen runs / 24 states: 896 coordinates, expected additive difference 0.05 within 1e-6, exact in-memory/managed-spill equality, bounded history and object/ledger checks. Independent recomputation and CSV verification passed.
- Nine synthetic PDF/PNG pairs and three actual-model views inspected. Foreground RStudio map/comparison/timeline and PDF/CSV export passed; user workspace, RNG, paths, environment, options and layout restored. Very narrow panes can clip captions; documented wide-pane/redraw or 10x7-inch export guidance.
- Vignette executed; final source build/scoped package check: 0 errors, 2 intentionally omitted-vignette warnings, no NOTE. Full ordinary CI remains pending.
- Existing accepted F6b DLL reused unchanged; no native build, model download or renewed native/sanitizer claim. External package patch-version warnings remain recorded.

All failed runs and exact source manifests are retained. The separate main model-tolerance nightly [37610986083](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37610986083) lacks an installed package for its lifecycle child; its diagnosis is recorded, and this PR does not modify or rerun that workflow.

See [implementation and limitations](docs/f6c-implementation.md), [graphics guide](rebirth/vignettes/model-interventions.qmd), [memory ledger](docs/f6c-memory-contract.md), and [acceptance receipts](tests/graphics/measurements/acceptance-20261007/README.md). Final exact-head checks and specific merge consent remain required. F6d/F6e are not started.
